backend.note: Verified against an already-running backend process (pid confirmed live, uptime >11h at time of check) rather than starting a second instance, to avoid leaving duplicate development servers running. A second `python3 app.py` was attempted and correctly failed with 'Address already in use' on port 5000, confirming no duplicate was started.

frontend.note: The Flask backend serves the built frontend (frontend/dist) directly; confirmed by fetching /, /workspace, /markets, /research and by capturing Playwright screenshots of the rendered pages (see data/stabilization/baseline/screenshots/). No separate `npm run dev` server was left running.
